habitat: Subtropical/tropical moist montane forests; bamboo thickets; and scrub
story: The Golden Parrotbill (Suthora verreauxi) is an extraordinary bird that belongs to the Paradoxornithidae family. It is most commonly observed in Subtropical/tropical moist montane forests; bamboo thickets; and scrub, where its behaviors contribute to the ecological dynamics of the area. Listed as Least Concern (LC) by the IUCN, this species' future depends on continued conservation action. The story of the Golden Parrotbill is one of adaptation and resilience, offering valuable lessons for conservationists. This poster aims to bring the Golden Parrotbill into focus, highlighting its beauty and the importance of its habitat.
